versions.changelog: Fixed water shattering at low zoom, where simplification had fattened narrow streams into slivers far wider than the real watercourse, and rebalanced demand-point detail so mid-density residential areas hold consistent detail while city centres keep full resolution.
Sharpened commute routing to match the national travel survey, corrected village residential counts against the census, and removed remaining malformed building footprints and over-drawn foundations.
Added modeled coastal seafloor depth from real bathymetry, per-building foundation depth, and public-library commute demand points.
Fixed small streams and buried canals rendering as blocking surface water, stopped admin-boundary parks painting green over villages, and added traditional municipal flags.
Expanded rendered greenery across more landuse types and added hospital, port, convention-center, stadium, and cultural-center demand, plus multi-campus university splitting.
Improved coastline and inland river rendering, stopped neighbouring-city labels from bleeding across bundles, and refined the workplace-side commute distribution.
Added the initial Taiwan map pack — Taipei, Taichung, Kaohsiung, Tainan, Hsinchu, and Chiayi — with census-calibrated residents and workers, NLSC LoD1 buildings, and airport and university demand.
